name: killer investingations
overview: Killer Investigations" goes inside America’s most gripping homicide cases. From crime scenes and interrogations to bodycam footage and courtroom showdowns, every moment is raw, real, and unfiltered. Watch detectives chase down leads, prosecutors go head-to-head with defense attorneys, and juries wrestle with life-or-death decisions. At the heart of every episode are the victims and families whose lives were shattered.
